about: The Shared Recipe Library's starter list (Emily, 2026-10-18: 500 to start, then 200 more on 2026-10-20, then 45 gap-fillers on 2026-10-20 (vegan and vegetarian, gluten-free, 45 minutes or less), then 100 more on 2026-10-25 (more quick dinners, and more for the thinner cuisines), every cuisine in the select). Dishes only: seed_recipe_library.py researches each into the library through recipe_library.file_entry(origin='seed'), and only after Emily approves the samples. dish_key is recipe_research.dish_key(dish_name), the key the library and the planner share.
